meta.title: Leonida Platinum Atlas
meta.note: All 55 names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them (via Exophase and PSNProfiles, which agree). Every guide below is written in our own words for this entry; facts are cited to the sources listed per trophy. Where no source has pinned a trophy down yet, the guide says so honestly instead of inventing steps.

sources.name: OutputLag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (official list)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 trophies are done — there is nothing extra to do for it. Treat it as a progress meter, not a task: follow the roadmap stages in order and it pops at the end. No online trophies, no DLC, and one playthrough is enough.
steps: Finish roadmap stages 1–6 in order
Earn A Long Road (100% completion) last or near-last
The platinum pops automatically once the 54th trophy lands

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission, Gone Fishing, ends with this popping — you cannot miss it. Just play the first mission through. It is the first story trophy and the gentlest possible start to the list.
steps: Start a new game
Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. It pops as the chapter closes — chapter trophies can land at the start of the next chapter instead, so do not worry if it arrives a mission late. Nothing to do but finish the chapter's missions.
steps: Play through every Chapter 1 main mission
The trophy pops as Chapter 1 closes

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Automatic at the end of the chapter. Chapter 2 is also where Breakfast Run unlocks switching between Jason and Lucia, which opens up most partner trophies.
steps: Play through every Chapter 2 main mission
The trophy pops as Chapter 2 closes

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. PowerPyx notes it lands after the first two missions of Chapter 4, so do not worry if it pops a little late — chapter trophies sometimes arrive at the start of the next chapter. Nothing to do but play the story.
steps: Play through every Chapter 3 main mission
Start Chapter 4; the trophy lands after its first two missions

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. PowerPyx notes it lands after the final main mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero. Automatic — just finish the chapter.
steps: Play through every Chapter 4 main mission
Finish Starting From Zero to close the chapter

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Automatic — the story's last mission ends the game and pops this gold. Keep a manual save from just before it: there is no mission replay, and a save lets you revisit the ending freely while free-roam cleanup continues after the credits.
steps: Keep a manual save before the final mission
Play the final mission to the end

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. Automatic during the mission — and it matters beyond itself, because this mission unlocks switching between Jason and Lucia, which most partner trophies need.
steps: Reach Chapter 2
Play the Breakfast Run mission to the end

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. Automatic story trophy — play the heist mission through and it pops.
steps: Reach Chapter 3
Play The Cartel Heist to the end

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play in Chapter 4. Automatic story trophy — play the mission through and it pops.
steps: Reach Chapter 4
Play Child's Play to the end

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners in Chapter 4. Automatic story trophy — play the mission through and it pops.
steps: Reach Chapter 4
Play Headliners to the end

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. Automatic story trophy — play the mission through and it pops.
steps: Reach Chapter 4
Play VCIA Takedown to the end

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. Automatic story trophy — play the mission through and it pops.
steps: Reach Chapter 5
Play Operation Savage Glory to the end

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion — the hardest trophy in the set, and the last one most players earn. The checklist appears after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but work done earlier already counts. It is lenient, closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not needed, collectibles only partly, and you need 70 of 80 challenges. The only all-of-them requirements are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Scan 200 of 277 vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals, finish any 100 optional missions.
steps: Finish the story first
Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion
Work the checklist in free-roam — nothing on it is missable
Scan 200 of 277 vehicles and study 100 of 255 animals
Finish 70 of 80 challenges and 100 optional missions

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts, any mix of the 397: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. The 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past 250. Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest to do. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots, where every stunt has a unique name and stays marked once done.
steps: Open the map > Exploration > Stunt Spots to see them all
Start with under-the-bridge flights — the quickest category
Mix in stunt jumps, knife flights and base jumps to reach 250
Keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check Progress > Activities — scrolling over each type shows how many you have done. Most come naturally from the story and other trophies, and the map's blue dumbbell filter marks activity spots.
steps: Open Progress > Activities to see the 9 types
Do one of each — story play already covers most
Use the map's Activities filter to find any type you still miss

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges — 42 golds across 12 range locations at two shooting ranges. The golds are not too difficult, and shooting ranges are also required in full for the 100% checklist, so this is not wasted effort. Work through the ranges one by one and chase gold on each challenge.
steps: Find a shooting range (12 locations, two ranges)
Play each challenge until you earn its gold medal
42 golds in total — ranges are also needed in full for 100%

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 locations with 42 drone races in total, and one win per location is enough. Drone race wins also feed the race count for Earn Cash, Not Kudos, so work the two trophies together.
steps: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race locations
Win at least one race at each location
Wins here also count toward Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across the 40 unique race locations — car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races all count. Pick the easiest 20; street races from Yago's strand count too. There is no need to win every race type, just 20 different ones.
steps: Race at 20 different locations (40 exist)
Top Fun drone race wins count too
Yago's street races count as well

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal texts you a fishing spot marked with a purple map icon. Follow his fishing questline and beat him at it — fishing also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
steps: Play Chapter 1's Feng Shui (Meet Cal)
Wait for Cal's text with the fishing spot
Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. There are four in-game video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind — playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1 — plus Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines around the world. Finish all levels of any one game once; you do not need to beat every challenge in it. Pick whichever you like best.
steps: Pick any of the 4 video games
Play it at the TV at home, or Bang For Your Buck at an arcade machine
Finish all of its levels once

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Her questline is Lucia-only and marks automatically in Chapter 3: Andy calls, then texts her home address in Belville. Five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass — and all of them stay available after the story.
steps: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 and wait for Andy's call
Follow the Belville marker to start her questline
Finish all 5 Andy quests, ending with Puff Puff Pass

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. His questline marks automatically in Chapter 1; after Island Dreams (Work for Kenton) he calls and is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — find the chests with the metal detector and bring them back. Kenton goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2–3 (calling Brian as Jason can speed it up). Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.
steps: Play Chapter 1's Island Dreams (Work for Kenton)
Follow the KR marker in Key Lento
Dive 7 shipwrecks and bring the treasure back
If Kenton goes quiet, keep playing — he returns in Chapters 2–3

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. His questline marks automatically after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Five quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, Hometown Heroes — and all of them stay available after the story.
steps: Finish Chapter 2's Coffee Break
Follow the marker to Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County
Finish all 5 Billy quests, ending with Hometown Heroes

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only certain questlines count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count as strangers, because they have their own trophies. Confirmed counting strands: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries) — more are still being found. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. Watch out: Yago's Race Against Yago is time-sensitive (hourglass icon) — do it the moment it appears, with a save first.
steps: Do Kirk's, Kyle's, Yago's and Pilot Pete's strands
Check the trophy counter after each strand
Do Race Against Yago the moment it appears (time-sensitive)
Find 4 more counting strands to reach 8

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. His Randy's Wish List marks automatically after Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered — track them under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List. Scan high-end cars with WAiNK to check them against the list, then drive them to his garage in west Vice City; good condition pays more. Still doable after the story.
steps: Finish Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS
Open Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List
Scan sports cars with WAiNK and deliver the 16 he wants

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. His questline is Jason-only and marks automatically after Chapter 3's Here, Kitty Kitty. Destroy the Synthetic Labs (purple markers, quest Take Out Kitty Litter), then Tyrone's second quest Spin On This shuts the labs down. All of it stays available after the story.
steps: Play as Jason after Chapter 3's Here, Kitty Kitty
Destroy the Synthetic Labs (Take Out Kitty Litter)
Finish Tyrone's second quest, Spin On This

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditation spots at 10 locations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts double (+2), and the last spot needs both characters together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2). Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. MISSABLE: the first meditation, on the balcony of Jason's house, only happens in Chapter 1 — after Down to Earth, Lucia mentions meditating in the kitchen in the morning, walks to the balcony, and you follow and accept. It adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a spot, and it is NOT yet confirmed whether the trophy strictly needs it — do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. For 100% you only need 15 of 18.
steps: Ch 1 only: after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen
Follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation
Keep a manual Chapter 1 save until this trophy pops
Meditate at all 18 spots — bring your partner (+2 each)
Last spot needs both characters (after Coffee Break)
trophies.missable_note: End of Chapter 1. Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house is offered once and never returns. Not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it — do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save.
trophies.unconfirmed_note: Not yet confirmed whether the Chapter 1 balcony meditation is strictly required for the trophy — PowerPyx says it is still undergoing confirmation.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's questline marks automatically after Chapter 2's Coffee Break — as Jason you get a text marking Veteran Hunted in Lummox County (Jason-only). He gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle (retrieve it from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker) and marks hunting spots; bring him the animals he requests. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine and pays more. It is still being confirmed which animal exactly unlocks this — the questline has 15 Target Decks, all needed for 100%, so work it through and it should land.
steps: After Coffee Break, wait for Bret's text as Jason
Meet Bret (Veteran Hunted, Lummox County)
Hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him
Work through all 15 Target Decks
trophies.unconfirmed_note: Not yet confirmed which animal exactly unlocks this trophy — PowerPyx says it is still undergoing confirmation.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 card set locations in total — collect the cards around Leonida and finish any 3 full sets. Cards also count toward the 100% checklist in part, so collect as you go rather than saving them all for the end.
steps: Find collectible cards around Leonida (18 set locations)
Complete any 3 full sets
Cards also count toward the 100% checklist

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Hold up on the D-pad then R1 to scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags; more than 100 exist, so scan any 100. Scanning vehicles with WAiNK also counts toward Whip It Good, so scan everything you pass.
steps: Hold up on the D-pad, then R1 to scan
Scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures as you travel
Any 100 scans count — there are more than 100 to find

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. 80 exist and 100% needs 70, so this pops on the way to the platinum. Track them under Progress > Challenges; many complete naturally while you play. Save the easiest ones for last, then pick the quickest of what remains.
steps: Open Progress > Challenges to see them all
Let most complete naturally while chasing other trophies
Pick the easiest remaining challenges to reach 50 (70 for 100%)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Earliest after Coffee Break (Chapter 2), when you can call your partner (hold right on the D-pad, press Triangle). Cause carnage to 4 stars, then escape the red heat zone — the trophy pops after leaving the heat zone, not the flashing search area. Easy escape: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops struggle on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. It also pops automatically during the Chapter 4 vault robberies, which always give 4 stars.
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner
Build a 4-star wanted level
Escape the red heat zone — try the train tunnel north of Ambrosia
Or let it pop automatically during the Chapter 4 bank vaults

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner, then hit 3 robbery targets (green icons) while the police chase you the whole time — keep the flashing wanted level alive, not the red heat level. The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after the third shop; if it does not pop, hit a 4th. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs). Wear an armored vest and carry Sticky Bombs and healing.
steps: Call your partner
Rob 3 shops in a row while the police chase you
Keep the flashing wanted level alive between shops
Wait ~30 seconds after the third shop; hit a 4th if it does not pop

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Use the WAiNK app (hold up to open it instantly), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive it. 557 vehicles exist at launch; stand on a busy road and scan traffic. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so this comes naturally. Check Progress > Vehicles.
steps: Open the WAiNK app (hold up on the D-pad)
Scan vehicles as they pass — no need to drive them
Any 100 discovered counts (200 of 277 base models for 100%)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is L3+R3 while aiming — time slows and weak spots are highlighted, and it drains the purple focus bar. Buff focus first (food, drinks, washing up at home, Adrenaline to extend it), then line up 5 enemies — gang members at an illegal operation are ideal — and drop them fast with an assault rifle like the Duke 556. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus levels up through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier later.
steps: Buff focus: eat, drink, use Adrenaline
Find 5 grouped gang enemies (an illegal operation works)
Activate Combat Focus (L3+R3 while aiming) and drop all 5 fast

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — planes parked on the airfield do not count. Easiest at gates E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the bridge, enter the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly about 1 km away and it pops (delayed). Save first — the police come fast.
steps: Go to VCIA and drive through a fence to the E3/E4 gates
Board the plane docked at the bridge and reach the cockpit
Reverse to the runway, take off and fly ~1 km away

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — steal a military tank. Tanks stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the far south-west of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, get in and shoot until it pops.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station (far south-west island)
Enter through the gate or the south-east stunt jump
Get in a tank in the south of the base and fire until it pops

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun and jewelry robberies. Use the Snap Gun on a locked back door (kicking it in sets off the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room, open the safe and leave unseen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If anyone spots you, reload.
steps: Finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to get the Snap Gun
Pick a jewelry store and use the Snap Gun on its back door
Find the safe code note, open the safe and leave unseen

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. It unlocks through the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe): tail a security van to a large bank and slip in while the guard has the vault open. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone (hold right to hand off a bag). After that, buy van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 a tip (after his Payday Loan jobs). Vaults instantly give a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch cars to go unrecognized. 8 large bank jobs exist; 100% needs all 8, and one vault can pay up to $205,000.
steps: Finish Chapter 4's That's Where The Money Is…
Tail a security van to a bank and enter while the vault is open
Bring your partner to carry the bags
Rob 5 vaults (8 for 100%); buy further van tips from Yasmani

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. It pops automatically in That's Where The Money Is… — tailing the armored truck to the bank and robbing the vault counts. Earlier method: block an armored truck driving near a bank, plant a Sticky Bomb on its back door and blow it, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky Bombs come from the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
steps: Play Chapter 4's That's Where The Money Is… — the vault robbery counts
Or stop an armored truck early: block it, Sticky Bomb its back door
Escape the red heat radius

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. Fastest by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the entire map is visible. It pairs naturally with the stunt flights for Cunning Stunts.
steps: Take a plane and fly over every fogged area
Watch the map fill in until no black fog remains

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs, 39 operations in total. One operation per gang is enough for the trophy; the 100% checklist needs all 39. Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track per gang under Progress > Gangs.
steps: Watch for yellow illegal-operation icons on the map
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs
Track per gang under Progress > Gangs (all 39 for 100%)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. UNCONFIRMED: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown — no verified steps exist yet. The description points at a cocktail with an Ocean Beach view, so the bars along Ocean Beach are the natural place to look, but this guide will not invent a fixed spot. Check back — it will be updated the moment players pin it down.
steps: No verified steps yet — listed honestly as unconfirmed
Try the bars along Ocean Beach
Check this guide again once players pin the trigger down
trophies.unconfirmed_note: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown — no verified steps exist yet.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the window — a GTA III easter egg. You need the Key Cloner first, from Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. Only the blue Banshee counts; the pop is slightly delayed, after you drive away down the street.
steps: Get the Key Cloner (Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs)
Go to the showroom in south Vice City
Steal the blue Banshee and drive it through the window

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Rob all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (an illegal operation, marked during Chapter 2's Hit Kingpin Bowling): the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on a table in the north-east corner, and the office safe in the north-east hallway — blow it with a Sticky Bomb (buy them at Ammu-Nation first). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. Not missable: if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later and you can grab what is left.
steps: Buy Sticky Bombs at an Ammu-Nation
Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (Chapter 2's Hit Kingpin Bowling)
Take the watch, the shotgun and the safe contents
Escape the police — the trophy pops then, not at the third item

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. After Coffee Break (Chapter 2) you can switch characters; buy a gym membership and always train together (call your partner) — while one works out, the other trains too, doubling progress. Check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia. Gyms are filterable on the map under Activities; you can also work out at home after the story.
steps: After Coffee Break, buy a gym membership
Always train with your partner along (double progress)
Bring both characters to maximum Strength

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse) — perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Turn on profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) and watch for the demon face on the right of the screen. Robberies, fights and escapes all feed it, and it fills passively while you chase other trophies. Profiles run Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho, then Irredeemable — the last one is permanent, so avoid it: cops shoot on sight more often.
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI
Play normally — robberies and fights feed the counter
It fills passively; check the count on the trophy itself

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. UNCONFIRMED: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue. No verified steps exist yet — this guide lists it honestly rather than inventing a method. Watch the Payday Loan shops as you play and check back.
steps: No verified steps yet — listed honestly as unconfirmed
Believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue
Check this guide again once players pin the trigger down
trophies.unconfirmed_note: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — the UFO easter egg. Go solo, at night after 2AM, to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and come back. Follow the path into the woods from the car and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light). Approach it — it drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside. The spawn is slightly random, not guaranteed.
steps: Go solo, at night after 2AM, to the road north-west of Starlet Motel (Kelly County)
Look for the blinking car at the roadside — if absent, drive away and return
Follow the path into the woods to the UFO
Approach it, talk to the woman it drops, then return to her car

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. UNCONFIRMED: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. No verified steps exist yet — the working theory is a melee kick from a moving bike. This guide will update once players confirm it.
steps: No verified steps yet — listed honestly as unconfirmed
Working theory: kick enemies while driving a motorcycle
Check this guide again once players pin the trigger down
trophies.unconfirmed_note: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish Chapter 3's Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most). The $250,000 is cumulative across robberies. Bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 in a single job.
steps: Finish Chapter 3's Credit Check to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer
Rob banks and Payday Loans for marked bills
Bring the bills to a fence — Yasmani pays the most
Cumulative $250,000 across all robberies

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — cumulative across every shop type. Fastest on the expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. There are 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 11 tattoo studios and more — spending on cars, clothes and weapons all counts.
steps: Spend across any shops — the $100,000 is cumulative
Fastest: guns, car mods and tattoos
It fills naturally while gearing up for other trophies

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 purchasable garages (plus 4 story garages that do not count), about $160,000 in total. They unlock after Chapter 2's Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone. Buy them through the app. Robberies in Chapters 3–4 are the quick way to fund them — and garages also add the parking spots On the Spot needs.
steps: Finish Chapter 2's Daily Driver
Open the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone
Buy all 8 garages (~$160,000 total)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after Chapter 2's Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). Buy garages first — each adds parking spots. Drive a stolen car to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, cars with standard trackers can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money — use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
steps: Buy garages first (Little Boxes) for parking spots
Finish Chapter 2's Moses to get the Scooter Bros app
Drive stolen cars to Moses in Port Gellhorn
Choose Respray, then Register — 10 vehicles in total
